purpose: Complete same-shard serial greedy parity and average >=25 observations/s per allocated GPU.
reference: Serial greedy in the optimized B4 tensor runtime, no draft or static tree; fused operations, split attention and graphs retained.
timing: Decoded CPU RGB/state to parsed CPU actions. Common job wall additionally includes auditing/reporting and slow-replica tail; excludes disk decoding, loading, graph capture, warmup, HTTP and simulator.
admission: All 2997 token/action/stop/cache-length/text records exact; actual observations / common wall seconds / 2 >= 25. No padded rows, tokens or action slots counted as observations.
limitations: Recorded replay only; no SR/SPL, HTTP or multi-node result.
Profile is limited to the tested B4 R2R checkpoint/library/GPU configuration.
The short-replay margin over 25/s is small.
Earlier unguarded learned draft results are not serial-reference admitted.
